text:
- **Owner questions:** Ask-tool questions now get answered on the site as well as in chat. Owner replies reach a session by push alone, with no reply wait.
- **Agents file checks:** The AGENTS.md check now gives the same verdict on every rerun. Pull requests grade it in diff mode, and full grading runs daily on main.
- **Session setup:** The new pm release now runs in this repo. pm no longer installs a git hook, and Claude Code's auto memory is off.
- **Test runs:** The Go service test now picks its own free port. `make test-go` passes on every run.
